The starter chose the user, not the program; "normally" covers set-user-ID programs.

gitattributes: "the default is eol=crlf on Windows and eol=lf on all other platforms"; "When a matching file is added to the index, the file's line endings are normalized to LF in the index." The lesson now conditions the carry-over on "a copy that moves the file as it is" / "a plain copy", matching the Git exception.
Directory.GetCurrentDirectory: "Gets the current working directory of the application." Returns "A string that contains the absolute path of the current working directory".

AppContext.BaseDirectory: "Gets the file path of the base directory of the application." Execution prints "this program lives in: ...\samples\DonHang.Samples\bin\Debug\net10.0\" from both folders while the working directory differs.

GetFullPath(String) Remarks: "This method uses the current directory and current volume information to fully qualify path." Returns "The fully qualified location of path". Execution: "'app.conf' therefore means '...\examples\don-hang\app.conf'".

File.ReadAllText(String) Exceptions: FileNotFoundException "The file specified in path was not found."; UnauthorizedAccessException "... -or- The caller does not have the required permission." Execution as uid 65534 on a mode-000 file: "found, but not allowed to read: Access to the path '/tmp/q/app.conf' is denied."

FileName docs only say "Gets the name of the file that cannot be found." Execution settles the full-path part: relative "app.conf" handed in, sample prints "not found: F:\...\examples\don-hang\app.conf" (Windows host) and "not found: /tmp/app.conf" (Linux, working directory /tmp).

stat --help in lab box: "%A permission bits and file type in human readable form", "%U user name of owner", "%G group name of owner", "%n file name". Output "-rw-r--r-- root:root app.conf" shows that order.
Execution: before `chmod 600` "-rw-r--r-- root:root app.conf", after "-rw------- root:root app.conf".
Execution: `cd /tmp; (cd /; pwd); pwd` -> "/" then "/tmp"; permissions.sh prints "working directory: /tmp/demo" then "working directory: /" around `cd /`.

permissions.sh l.5 at stage-0: `[ -f /.dockerenv ] || exec "$(dirname "$0")/../lab-run.sh" "$0" "$@"`; lab-run.sh execs `docker compose exec -T lab bash ...`. Run from the host today prints "who is this process running as: root" and "-rw-r--r-- root:root app.conf", identical to the lesson output block.

Execution in lab box: CRLF script "echo one / ls / echo two" run with bash -> "one", "/tmp/crlf.sh: line 2: $'ls\r': command not found", "two", rc=0. Even a CRLF `set -e` line only fails ("set: -: invalid option") and later lines still run.

Execution: `dotnet run --project samples/DonHang.Samples -- read-config-file` from repo top prints "working directory: ...\examples\don-hang"; `dotnet run --project . -- read-config-file` from samples/DonHang.Samples prints "working directory: ...\samples\DonHang.Samples".

Execution: third line "'app.conf' therefore means '...\don-hang\app.conf'" and fourth "not found: ...\don-hang\app.conf" name the same path; on Linux "/tmp/q/app.conf" appears in both the third line and the access-denied message.

Execution: root reads a mode-000 file ("x" printed) in donhang-api; in lab box `su tuser -c "cat /tmp/p/f"` on "-rw------- root:root" -> "cat: /tmp/p/f: Permission denied"; permissions.sh as root reads app.conf after chmod 600 ("port=8080").

Lab box help: whoami "Print the user name associated with the current effective user ID."; mkdir "-p, --parents"; rm "-r, -R, --recursive", "-f, --force". permissions.sh output: printf > app.conf then `cat app.conf` -> "port=8080"; $(whoami) inserted into the echo line ("... running as: root").

Execution: `ls /nope 2>&1 >/dev/null | cat` shows the error on stdout; `false || echo ran` -> "ran", `true || echo notran` prints nothing. permissions.sh: "cat: app.conf: No such file or directory" then "the same relative path now finds nothing".

dotnet-run.md l.264: "--project <PATH> Specifies the path of the project file to run (folder name or full path)."; l.188: "The -- separator marks every following token as an application argument". stage-0 Program.cs: `["read-config-file"] = Sync(ReadConfigFile.Run)`. stat --help: %A "permission bits and file type in human readable form". Output "-rw-r--r--" for a regular file created by printf, "-rw-------" after chmod 600: leading "-" = regular file, then owner/group/others triplets.
